reviews.comment: Dr. Howard was super engaging in his lectures and he truly made important matters in our current society super interesting and fun to debate. He is super understanding and acknowledges the different skill sets students may have. There were weekly assignments from the textbook, pop quizzes, and the final paper. The final paper is very important!

He is a very cool and laid-back professor. The class is a low time commitment until the end of the year when you have the paper due. Sometimes expectations of assignments were confusing, but he is very nice and helpful. The end-of-year paper grade determines the entire course grade which was stressful, but other than that great course.

Homework every week, only one exam which is the final. Good to email with problems and he will respond quickly and efficiently. Very understanding and considerate of your problems, but had troubles posting grades when needed.

Dr. Howard is one of the best profs I've had. He cares about his students and cares whether they learn or not. His lectures were always very entertaining and were spent going over readings and making concepts clear. The concepts that we did go over made this one of the hardest and most rewarding classes I have taken. Majority of the grade is papers

Professor Howard is a really cool professor. He makes class fun and understanding once he explains things. He leaves lectures up for open discussion, but it is very beneficial if you read the texts he tells you to read before class. If you don't, you won't have any idea what is going on in class. His tests are very specific to the texts.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Super cool professor, very understanding when it comes to his quizzes and final paper. The text is somewhat difficult, but he makes it fun and understandable. Lectures are amazing, overall enjoyable and easy class.
Pretty good lecturer but he lets some students dominate conversation some topics were boring but overall good class for CD requirement.
